# YAMAS - Taverna Greca

> Authentic Greek restaurant (taverna) in San Vitaliano (NA), Italy. Traditional dishes such as moussaka, souvlaki, and gyros, with vegetarian options.

- Address: Via Nazionale delle Puglie 69, 80030 San Vitaliano (NA), Italy
- Phone / WhatsApp: +39 081 344 50 57
- Hours: Monday-Sunday, 19:30-23:00
- Cuisine: Greek, vegetarian options available
- Price range: €€
